column1: # INNOVERSE — curated attested-parallel corpus for gap reconstruction (retrieval / RAG)
# WHAT: a small, hand-checked set of standard, widely published Akkadian formulae —
#       mostly Old Assyrian merchant letters and accounts (Kanesh/karum) plus a few
#       Old Babylonian and Neo-Assyrian royal formulae. Old Assyrian and royal texts
#       are famously formulaic, so a real fragment usually has a close attested
#       parallel here. The reconstruction engine retrieves the closest line and
#       CITES it as evidence next to the model's estimate.
# WHY : this is what makes the Gap tool "grounded" rather than a free guess — on a
#       genuine formulaic fragment it can point at the real attested line it matched.
# NOTE   : transliterations use this project's plain-ASCII convention (sz = š, no
#          diacritics) so they match what the cuneiform keyboard produces. Glosses
#          are teaching guide-words, not critical editions.
# LICENSE: formulae drawn from open Oracc editions (RINAP / SAAo / OA archives),
#          reused under CC BY-SA 3.0 with attribution. See ATTRIBUTIONS.md.
